findings.issue: No test runner, test script, or test dependencies; the app ships with zero tests of its own
findings.suggestion: Add vitest for the pure modules (lib/format.ts, lib/cards.ts, URL-state helpers) plus a couple of Playwright component/route tests; these are cheap given how much logic is already extracted into pure functions

findings.issue: cardsFor implements the spec's most error-prone rules (drop IDs > 10000, dedup by species id, sort by dex number) with no coverage
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with refs containing alternate forms, duplicate species and out-of-order IDs

findings.issue: URL-state logic (page NaN/negative clamping, q trimming, toQuery omitting defaults, searching→page-1 reset at :107-109) is untested
findings.suggestion: Extract filters/params logic and unit-test edge cases: ?page=0, ?page=99999, combined q+type+generation, rapid typing vs debounce

findings.issue: In-memory cache's subtle behaviour (TTL eviction, failed-promise cleanup at :56-58, NotFoundError on 404, re-rooting via indexOf at :46) has no regression guard; indexOf -1 silently corrupts the path
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a stubbed fetch: 404→NotFoundError, rejection evicts cache entry, absolute URLs with and without /api/v2/ prefix, TTL expiry

findings.issue: decodeURIComponent(name) throws URIError on malformed percent sequences before notFound() runs, turning /pokemon/%zz into a 500 instead of the not-found page (same pattern in moves/abilities/types pages)
findings.suggestion: Wrap decode in try/catch returning '' or validate the name before decoding; add a route test for malformed-encoding URLs

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavorText, cleanText, idFromUrl, dexNumber are pure spec-critical helpers with no tests
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests covering \f/\n collapsing, no-en-entry fallback, non-numeric URLs, id 25 → #0025

findings.issue: Sort comparators (missing-values-last ignoring sort direction, compareMethods Infinity sentinels) and the composite row key at :140 are untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the sort function with null power/accuracy mixed with numbers, and both sort directions

findings.issue: Type-per-slot and generation-by-id map building (server-side data transformation over 18 type records × 1025 species) is untested
findings.suggestion: Extract into lib/ and unit-test slot ordering, missing types, and generation fallback to ''

findings.issue: The lastWritten-ref/debounce sync between the input and the URL is stateful and easy to break; no test pins the observable behaviour
findings.suggestion: Playwright test typing then backspacing quickly, asserting both results and final URL

findings.issue: No error.tsx anywhere; a non-404 API failure surfaces as an unhandled 500 with no tested fallback
findings.suggestion: Add an app-level error boundary and a test simulating API 500s

summary: The app ships zero tests of its own — no runner, script, or dependency — leaving its substantial pure-logic layer (name/formatting rules, alternate-form filtering, URL-state parsing, move sorting, a 30s TTL cache) guarded only by the acceptance suite. That suite is behavioural and reasonably broad, but it exercises happy-path URLs only, so a refactor of the data layer or a subtle cache/parse bug (e.g. decodeURIComponent throwing before notFound()) would slip through. Ironically the code is well-structured for testing — most risk already lives in pure, easily-testable functions — which makes the absence of any tests a clear miss rather than a structural limitation.
